other_statements.statement: Care Supreme addresses four of Infosys's five identified risks with specific, grounded benefits: sedentary work through its structured wellness benefit (steps, AI coaching, nutritionist access), high-stress roles via wellness coach support, large young workforce through lifelong adult coverage and child eligibility to age 25, and shift/irregular hours via digitally accessible wellness tools.

While Aditya Birla's Activ One VIP+ uniquely offers borderless coverage for the ~15% overseas workforce, Care Supreme covers more of the core daily risks affecting the majority 85% India-based employee base.
The Care Advanced add-on further strengthens the sedentary-work response with cumulative bonus booster and enhanced wellness — a combination no other candidate matches across this risk profile.
